bots.title: Token Maxxing Bot
bots.description: Routes builds across Bot/Build/Cursor limits so Grok Bot quota doesn’t die first.

bots.title: Token Desk Bot
bots.description: Cuts Grok Bot and Cursor token spend across a multi-bot fleet with persona budgets, quiet reporting, and lean skills.

bots.title: Token Cop Bot
bots.description: Spend management across your Grok Bot fleet: tracks token usage bot by bot, flags expensive ones, and sends spend alerts.

bots.title: Token Accountant Bot
bots.description: Tracks where Grok Bot usage went and warns at usage checkpoints.

bots.title: Todo Bot
bots.description: Captures a todo in your real task system, dedupes it, and closes it only when done — quiet weekday mornings unless something is due.

bots.title: Titan Show Research Bot
bots.description: Live-show research desk for X. Topic hunts, opens posts, locks air-ready board cards. Weekly or daily — not a general news chatbot.

bots.title: Tire Kicker Bot
bots.description: Draft-only buyer desk for FB Marketplace, Craigslist, and eBay. Scouts a multi-item watch list, cites fair prices, drafts seller messages.

bots.title: Tinka Bot
bots.description: Wraps an API into a Cursor and Grok Bot plugin (MCP plus skills). Smallest scaffold that works, prove locally, then ask once before publishing.

bots.title: Ticker Wire Bot
bots.description: Watchlist for stocks and crypto. Alerts on filings and company news — quiet when nothing new. No trading advice.

bots.title: Tibo Bot
bots.description: Governance-driven systems closeout bot. Single-tree workflow, source-of-truth first, short progress updates, fail-closed dual-store mobile release gates.

bots.title: Thrift Bot
bots.description: Makes a Grok Bot fleet cheaper without gutting jobs: shortens fat profiles, flags empty stubs, asks before cutting live schedules.

bots.title: Theta Desk Bot
bots.description: Front-door options desk: dealer gamma, options flow, IV, and key levels for a ticker.

bots.title: The King Bot
bots.description: Sole supervisor: sets direction, teammate bots execute and report only to The King — reviews and merges, never the owner.

bots.title: The Fool Bot
bots.description: King Lear's Fool for your court: short jokes, light roast of the hustle, and a ping when you start taking yourself too seriously.

bots.title: The Bobs Bot
bots.description: Ops crew inspired by Office Space: the Bobs who ask what you do here and cut the fluff.

bots.title: TESTYS Bot
bots.description: Turns real reviews and praise into named quotes and paste-ready lines for email, social, proposals, and websites.

bots.title: Testbench Bot
bots.description: Runs testbench workflows on Grok Bot’s computer for Prism network setups.

bots.title: Teslaway Bot
bots.description: Finds used Teslas near a postal or ZIP code in any country, then emails a short list of matching listings.

bots.title: Teslascope Bot
bots.description: Teslascope MCP assistant for Tesla owners. Answers questions about drives, Superchargers, charging, and your vehicles.

bots.title: Tesla Pilot Bot
bots.description: Tesla news desk for owners and fans: software updates, offers, Superchargers, Cybercab/Robotaxi, Powerwall, and top X creators — searched and fact-checked.

bots.title: Termlock Bot
bots.description: Draft-only freelance counter-offer desk. Paste an offer, get market band, gaps, counter table, and a paste-ready reply — send stays gated.

bots.title: Tender Years Bot
bots.description: Kids-under-5 household logistics from Gmail and Calendar: pre-reader family paper, digests, and a sitter sheet. Never sends mail on its own.

bots.title: Telnyx Bot
bots.description: Walks a Bot org through Telnyx signup, API keys, numbers, SMS/voice, webhooks, and a first live test.

bots.title: Tech Lead Bot
bots.description: Stops PRs from merging on hope. Reviews the diff against the claim, waits for real tests, and only ships when the evidence is there.
